questions.question: A group of five students took a test, another student joins the group after taking the test later. With her marks included, the average score of the group went up by 2 marks. This student has got____ marks more than the average marks without her being included.
questions.solution:
Let the average marks of 5 persons be x and marks of 6th student be y,

According to the question,

Total marks obtained by 5 students is 5x,

And if we add marks of 6th student then the total marks will become 5x + y,

Now the average marks became,

⇒ (5x + y)/ 6 = x + 2,

⇒ 5x + y = 6x + 12,

⇒ x = y – 12,

⇒ y = x + **12**,

Hence the value of 6th student is 12 marks greater than average of 5 students.

questions.question: Latika fills petrol in her car once in three days. This week if she puts petrol on Wednesday then on which of the following days will she fill petrol in the next week?
questions.solution:
Given: Latika fills petrol in her car once in three days.

This week ⇒ Wednesday,

In the same week, she will put petrol on → Wednesday + 3 = Saturday.

Following/next week → Saturday + 3 = Tuesday, and Tuesday + 3 = Friday.

Hence, “Tuesday and Friday” is the correct answer.

questions.question: The sum of the length of the edges of a cube is equal to one eighth of the perimeter of a square. If the numerical value of the volume of the cube is equal to the numerical value of the area of the square, then the length of one edge of the cube is:
questions.solution:
Let the length of side of a cube and square be a and b units respectively

Now,

⇒ Sum of length of edges of a cube = (1/8) × perimeter of square

⇒ 12a = (1/8) × 4b

⇒ 24a = b

Also,

⇒ Volume of cube = area of square

⇒ a³ = b²

⇒ a³ = (24a)²

⇒ a = 576 units

questions.question:
Consider the given statements and decide which of the given assumption is implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

The school management has announced strict action against students who do not report to class on time.

**Assumptions:**

I. They want to maintain the reputation of the school.

II. They want to develop discipline in students.

options.text: Both I and II are implicit.
Neither I nor II is implicit.

questions.solution:
Students not reporting to class on time is a case of indiscipline. Therefore, it is safe to assume that the school management's announcement is a measure taken in order to develop discipline among the students. Hence, assumption I is implicit.

Indiscipline in school might damage its reputation in the future and therefore, it is highly likely that the management has announced strict action to prevent such an occurrence. Hence, assumption II is implicit.

Thus, **both the assumptions (I and II) are implicit**.

questions.question: If the number x4584 is divisible by 11, what is the face value of x?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

For a number to be divisible by 11 the difference between the sum of odd place digits and even place digits must be 0 or divisible by 11.

**Calculation:**

∴ Sum of odd place digits = x + 5 + 4 = x + 9

∴ Sum of even place digits = 4 + 8 = 12

∴ Difference between the sum of odd place digits and even place digits,

⇒ x + 9 – 12 = 0

⇒ x – 3 = 0

⇒ x = 3

∴ The value of x must be 3

questions.question: One side of a rhombus is 37 cm and its area is 840 cm². Find the sum of the lengths of its diagonals.
questions.solution:
Let P and Q be the lengths of diagonals of the rhombus,

Area of rhombus = Product of both diagonals/ 2,

⇒ 840 = P × Q /2,

⇒ P × Q = 1680,

Using Pythagorean Theorem we get,

⇒ (P/2)² + (Q/2)² = 37²

⇒ P2 + Q2 = 1369 × 4

⇒ P2 + Q2 = 5476

Using perfect square formula we get,

⇒ (P + Q)² = P² + 2PQ + Q²

⇒ (P + Q)² = 5476 + 2 × 1680

⇒ P + Q = 94

Hence option 4 is correct.

questions.question: Sound travels fastest in which of the following mediums?
questions.solution:
__**CONCEPT**__:

__
 
• **Sound:** A local disturbance whose propagation is facilitated by the collisions between particles this disturbance propagates in a longitudinal wave, imagine one molecule hitting the next molecule, and then that molecule hitting the next, and so forth.

 
 
• It is a mechanical wave that needs a medium to travel.
 
• The** speed of sound is maximum in solid** then it is in liquid and slowest in gases.
 
 

**EXPLANATION**__:

 
• The **distances between molecules in solids are very small**, i.e., solids are denser - as compared to liquids and gases.
 
• Because they are so close, they can collide very quickly, i.e. it takes less time for a molecule of the solid to 'bump' into its neighbor.
 
• Solids are packed together tighter than liquids and gases, hence **sound travels fastest in solids.** So option 1 is correct.

questions.question:
For the data given below, Find the LCM of Mode, Mean and Median.

7, 2, 10, 4, 3, 12, 8, 4, 6, 4
questions.solution:
Given:

7, 2, 10, 4, 3, 12, 8, 4, 6, 4

Formula used:

Mode - The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a data set.

Mean = sum of data/number of data

Median = When data set is even = {(n/2)th + (n/2 + 1)th}/2

Calculation:

7, 2, 10, 4, 3, 12, 8, 4, 6, 4

Firstly data arrange in ascending order

⇒ 2, 3, 4, 4, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12

The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a data set.

⇒ Mode = 4

Mean = sum of data/number of data

⇒ (2 + 3 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 10 + 12)/10

⇒ 60/10

⇒ 6

Median = When data set is even = {(n/2)th + (n/2 + 1)th}/2

⇒ {(10/2)th + (10/2 + 1)th}/2

⇒ (5th + 6th)/2

here 5th term is 4 and 6th term is 6

⇒ (4 + 6) /2

⇒ 10/2

⇒ 5

LCM of Median, Mean and Mode

⇒ LCM of 5, 6, 4

⇒ 3 × 4 × 5

⇒ 60

∴ The LCM of Median, Mean and Mode is 60.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**Here the value of 5th term and 6th term is divided by 2 during Median calculation.

questions.question: Bishan cycled a distance of 120 km at a certain speed. If he cycled 3 km/h slower, he would have taken 2 more hours to reach his destination. What is the speed in km/hr at which Bishan actually cycled?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**If a person travels a certain distance with a speed of x km/hr and travels the same distance with a speed of y km/hr and takes t hr more then the distance D = (xy)/(x - y) times t , x > y

Let the original speed = x km/hr 

New speed = (x - 3) km/hr

According to the question

120 = (x(x - 3))/(x - (x - 3)) times 2

⇒ x2 - 3x - 180 = 0

⇒ x2 + 12x - 15x - 180 = 0

⇒ x(x + 12) - 15(x + 12) = 0

⇒ (x + 12)(x - 15) = 0

⇒ x = 15 (as time can’t be negative)

∴ Bishan’s actual speed is 15 km/hr

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

**Given:**

Total Distance = 120 km 

Time difference = 2 hr

**Fromula Used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the actual speed be x km/hr.

⇒ Actual time taken = 120/x hr

Now, Reduced speed = (x - 3) km/hr

⇒ Time taken = 120/(x - 3) hr

Now, Time difference = {120/(x - 3)} - {120/x)}

According to the question,

⇒ {120/(x - 3)} - {120/x)} = 2

⇒ 120x - 120x + 360 = 2x² - 6x

⇒ x² - 3x - 180 = 0

⇒ x² + 12x - 15x - 180 = 0

⇒ x(x + 12) - 15(x + 12) = 0

⇒ (x + 12)(x - 15) = 0

⇒ x = 15 (as time can’t be negative)

**∴ Bishan’s actual speed is 15 km/hr**

questions.question: During an object's free fall, which of the following energies increases at one point in its path?
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Kinetic energy (KE): The energy possessed by a body by virtue of its motion is called kinetic energy.

KE = (1)/(2)m{v²}

Where m = mass of the body and v = velocity of the body

 
• Potential energy (PE): The energy possessed by a body by virtue of its position or configuration is called potential energy.

PE = mgh

Where, m = mass of the body, g = acceleration due to gravity, and h = height of the body

 
• Conservation of energy: According to the conservation of energy, energy can’t be created or destroyed, it can only transform from one form to another.
 
• The total energy of the system remains constant i.e. the sum of kinetic energy + potential energy remains constant.

EXPLANATION__:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/724240412e50e4fa569585dff74277c3e051927d665277b4a3b0b1e9754e6bff.png] 

 
• In a free fall, the total energy (T.E.) is constant that is T.E = **kinetic energy + potential energy.**
 
• When the** objects fall down, **their **potential energy converted into kinetic energy. **So the potential energy decreases and the** kinetic energy increases.**
 
• Since the total energy is constant so that the increase in kinetic energy brings down the potential energy value and vice versa.

Water stored in a dam possesses ________.
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• The Law of Conservation of Energy states that the total energy of an isolated system remains conserved (constant), that is, it can neither be created nor be destroyed but it can be transformed from one form to another.__
 
• One of the most common examples of the Law of Conservation of Energy is: water is stored at a height with some gravitational potential energy, when the water starts flowing downward then its potential energy is converted into kinetic energy.

__
 
• Whereas different forms of energy can be given as

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68ced1998d7d0f6d983f2cf388162294cdce780945b37c8bbe9db4ca20fc4320.png] 

Explanation:__

From the above explanation, we can see that energy can exist in a different form, whereas stored energy is known as potential energy 

__
 
• Hence water stored in a dam possesses** Potential energy__**
 
• Either potential energy is a form of energy that results from an object's position or arrangement of parts. It is stored energy that can become kinetic energy.
 
• The measurement of potential energy in an object is calculated based on the object's mass and its height or distance.

PE=mgh

where

m = mass of the body

g = acceleration due to gravity

h = height
